title: Ravenry page file, version 1
description: A Ravenry page: one *.page.yaml file that says where a page's items come from, how they are drawn and which buttons they have. Version 1 only grows by additions: no field is ever renamed, retyped or given a new default. Keys starting with x- are yours and are never read by Ravenry. Every pattern here is RE2-compatible, so the Go checker uses the same schema.

version.title: the number 1
version.description: The page format version. Always 1 for this format. A file with a higher number needs a newer Ravenry.

id.title: lower case letters, digits and -, starting with a letter, at most 40 long
id.description: The page's id. Pages are matched by id: a project page replaces a global page, which replaces the shipped default with the same id. The file is named <id>.page.yaml.

title.title: text of 1 to 80 characters
title.description: The page's title, shown at the top of the page and, unless nav.label says otherwise, in the sidebar.

revision.title: a whole number from 1
revision.description: Only in the pages Ravenry ships: the default's own revision, raised whenever the default changes. Customize writes it into the copy's from line.

from.title: <owner>/<id>@<revision>, such as ravenry/objectives@3
from.description: Stamped by Customize on a copy of a shipped page: which default it came from and that default's revision. Ravenry uses it to say when the default has changed since the copy. It never merges anything.

requires.title: a Ravenry version such as >=0.6 or >=0.6.2
requires.description: The oldest Ravenry that can draw this page. An older Ravenry shows a line asking for an update instead of the page.

sections.title: a list of sections
sections.description: What the page shows, top to bottom. A page has either sections or tabs.

tabs.title: a list of tabs
tabs.description: Instead of sections: a switch at the top of the page, each tab with its own sections.

actions.title: a list of buttons
actions.description: Buttons at the top of the page. They have no item, so their text cannot use {field}.

fieldName.title: a field name: lower case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 40 long

fieldPath.title: a field name, or a dotted path such as brief.goal
fieldPath.description: A field of the items. A provider's fields can hold fields of their own, reached with a dot: brief.goal.

pluginName.title: <plugin>:<name>, such as ravenry:plan
pluginName.description: A view or action from a plugin. Ravenry's own pieces use the ravenry: namespace.

relPath.title: a path inside the page's folder, such as notes/ (not starting with / or ~, no ..)

text.title: text
text.description: Text. In an item's buttons it can hold {field}, filled from that item's own fields as data.

word.title: a lower-case word
word.description: A name a newer Ravenry may know. This one warns and uses its default.

icon.title: an icon name such as flag
icon.description: One of Ravenry's icons: target, plans, idea, rules, ship, flag, list, cards, board, table, chart, doc, check, star, bug, inbox, clock, folder, terminal, tag, heart, bolt, page. An unknown name draws the page icon.

nav.title: a mapping
nav.description: The page's row in the sidebar (and on the phone).

label.title: text of 1 to 40 characters
label.description: The row's text. Defaults to the title.

count.title: true, false or a filter
count.description: The number after the label: true counts every item of the page's source, a filter counts the items it matches. Off when left out.

sum.description: Instead of count: the number after the label is this number field added up over the page's items.

count_label.title: text of 1 to 20 characters
count_label.description: A word after the number, such as running in "2 running".

route.title: a route: lower case letters, digits, - and /
route.description: Where the page opens in the app. Defaults to pages/<id>.

source.title: a mapping with one of folder, files or provider
source.description: Where the items come from: a folder of markdown files (one per item, fields in the frontmatter), files matched by a glob (read for their checkboxes), or a provider (Ravenry's own read-only data). A section can have its own source; otherwise it uses the page's.

folder.description: A folder of markdown files, one per item, next to the page file: playtest/ beside playtest.page.yaml. For a shipped page, beside where its copy would go (~/.ravenry/pages/). Each file's frontmatter holds the fields; its body is the item's text.

fields.title: a mapping of field names to fields
fields.description: With folder only: the fields each item has. They also build the New and Edit forms. Every item also has title, body, file, created and modified.

files.title: a glob such as docs/**/PLAN*.md
files.description: Markdown files matched by a glob inside the page's folder (the project's folder for a project page), one item per file, read for their checkboxes: done, total, title.

provider.title: a provider id such as projects, or <plugin>:<name>
provider.description: Ravenry's own data, read only: projects, brief, plans, plan-files, git, rule-files, repeats, sessions. Their field names are fixed (see providers-1.json). A plugin's provider is <plugin>:<name>.

field.title: a mapping with a type
field.description: One field of a folder's items.

type.title: one of string, number, date, bool, enum, list or image
type.description: string: one line of text. number. date: YYYY-MM-DD, or with a time. bool: true or false. enum: one of its values. list: a list of short texts. image: a picture file inside the page's folder (never a web address). A type from a newer Ravenry is read as text, with a warning.

label.title: text of 1 to 40 characters
label.description: The field's name in forms and table headers. Defaults to the field name, capitalised.

values.title: a list of values
values.description: With enum only: the values, in order. A board shows one lane per value in this order.

default.title: a value of the field's type
default.description: The value a new item starts with.

required.title: true or false
required.description: The New and Edit forms ask for it.

filter.title: a filter (a mapping)
filter.description: Which items to keep. Every line must hold. field: value keeps items whose field is that value; field: [a, b] keeps either; field: { gt: 0 } compares (gt, gte, lt, lte, not); has: field keeps items where the field is set and not empty; not: {filter} and any: [filters] combine. There are no formulas.

has.title: a field or a list of fields

scalar.title: text, a number or true or false

not.title: a value or a list of values

tab.title: a mapping with label and sections
tab.description: One tab of a page with tabs.

count.title: true, false or a filter
count.description: A number after the tab's name: true counts the items of its first section, a filter counts the ones it matches.

coreView.title: one of list, cards, board, table, stats or document
coreView.description: list: rows. cards: a grid of cards. board: lanes by an enum field, and dragging a card sets that field (below about 240 px a lane, a grouped list). table: rows and columns. stats: a row of numbers. document: each item's text as a document.

section.title: a mapping with a view
section.description: One part of a page: a view of items from a source.

view.title: a view: list, cards, board, table, stats, document or <plugin>:<name>
view.description: How the items are drawn: list, cards, board, table, stats, document, or a plugin's view such as ravenry:plan. A view this Ravenry does not know draws the section's fallback, or a placeholder.

sort.title: a list of fields, each optionally starting with -
sort.description: The order of the items: by the first field, then the next. Dates go newest first and everything else A to Z or smallest first; a - in front reverses it.

limit.title: a whole number from 1 to 500
limit.description: Show at most this many items, then an "N more" line.

empty.title: text of 1 to 200 characters
empty.description: What the section says when it has no items.

actions.title: a list of buttons
actions.description: Buttons above the section. Like the page's, they have no item.

fallback.title: a view name or a section
fallback.description: What to draw when this Ravenry does not know the view (a plugin that is not installed, or a view from a newer Ravenry): a core view name, which keeps the rest of the section, or a whole section.

group_by.description: Group the items by a field: a heading per value. A board needs it, and it must be an enum field there: one lane per value, and dragging a card to a lane sets the field.

columns.title: a list of columns
columns.description: The table's columns, left to right: a field, or { field, label, align }. Defaults to the title.

with.title: a mapping
with.description: Settings for a plugin's view, as that plugin documents them.

column.title: a field or { field, label, align }

stat.title: a mapping with a label and one of count, sum, min or max
stat.description: One number: count (true, or a filter) counts items; sum, min and max take a number field.

item.title: a mapping of slots
item.description: What each item shows. Every slot names a field; none holds text of its own.

title.description: The item's name. Defaults to title.

badges.title: a list of fields
badges.description: Small tags after the title, one per field that has a value.

progress.title: a number field, { done, total, style } or { list, style }
progress.description: A bar or dots: a number field from 0 to 100, done of total, or a list whose entries have a state (done, now, you, wait, todo). style is bar, dots or count.

image.description: A picture: an image field. Only files inside the page's folder are shown, never a web address.

time.description: A date field, shown as a time (16:52, Yesterday, Mon).

checklist.description: The checkboxes (- [ ] and - [x] lines) of a text field, usually body. They can be ticked when the item has a toggle button.

excerpt.description: The first lines of a text field, usually body.

place.description: A plugin's view drawn inside the item, such as ravenry:plan-row.

detail.description: A plugin's view shown when the item is opened, instead of its fields and text.

actions.title: a list of buttons
actions.description: The item's buttons. Their text can use {field} from this item.

action.title: a mapping with a label and one of open, set, create, toggle, copy, archive, ask, run or plugin
action.description: A button. It does exactly one thing, from a closed list. One this Ravenry does not know draws its fallback, or a button that is off.

label.title: text of 1 to 40 characters
label.description: The button's text. It never holds {field}, so a trust prompt can list it as written.

confirm.description: A question asked before the button does anything. Can use {field}.

when.description: Show the button only on items this filter keeps.

fallback.description: The button to show instead when this Ravenry does not know this one's kind (a plugin action that is not installed, or one from a newer Ravenry).

open.title: item, file, folder, or { page }, { link }, { project } or { session }
open.description: Opens something: item (the item, with its fields and text), file (its file in your editor), folder (its folder), { page: <id> } another page, { link: <field> } the address in a field (shown in full before it opens), { project: <text> } or { session: <text> } a project's or session's view.

set.title: a mapping of fields to values
set.description: Sets fields of the item's file, only to declared values: an enum field to one of its values, a bool field to true or false. The rest of the file stays as it is.

create.title: a mapping of fields to values
create.description: Opens the New form built from the fields, starting with these values. Saving writes a new file in the folder. Page and section buttons only.

toggle.title: body
toggle.description: Lets the item's checklist be ticked: each box flips its own line, after checking the line still says what the screen showed.

copy.description: Copies text to the clipboard. Can use {field}.

archive.title: true
archive.description: Moves the item's file into the folder's .archive/ folder. Undo moves it back.

ask.title: a mapping with prefill or background, and optionally session
ask.description: Asks an agent. prefill types the text into a session's box and waits for you to press Enter. background runs it on its own: Ravenry asks you the first time, and again whenever the page file changes. session names the project or session; defaults to the item's project. All three can use {field}.

run.title: a mapping with argv, and optionally env and cwd
run.description: Runs a program, always through approve-and-run: you see the command and approve every run. argv is fixed, word by word, with no {field} and no shell. Item data goes in only as environment variables: env maps a variable name to a field. cwd is a folder inside the page's folder (the project's for a project page).

env.title: a mapping of variable names to fields

propertyNames.title: an environment variable name in capitals, such as REGION

plugin.description: A plugin's action, such as ravenry:save-rule. with holds its settings.

with.title: a mapping
with.description: With plugin only: the action's settings, as that plugin documents them.
